channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Looking back 2025 | Podcasts, and rage bait, continued to change Malta’s media landscape
item.description: Looking back at 2025, two podcasts stand out among the fold because they elicited emotion and commanded social media engagement. In short, they knew how to outrage the masses and keep the attention on them

item.title: Free healthcare: We need to protect Malta’s best asset
item.description: I don’t think people realise what it must feel like to go to a hospital and be asked to fill out paperwork to confirm that you are covered by insurance before you are even seen

item.title: Looking back 2025 | How Ħamrun brought European football to Ta’ Qali
item.description: Finally, a nation obsessed with football could watch a Maltese team play European football well beyond the preliminary stages

item.title: Clayton Bartolo says his asset freeze has been lifted, claims he was victim of personal attack
item.description: MaltaToday is informed that Bartolo, through his lawyers, requested the asset freeze to be dropped. The order received no objections. The asset freeze imposed on his wife, Amanda Muscat, remains in effect

item.title: 48 people sent back to home country two weeks after rescue mission
item.description: After crossing the Mediterranean and surviving a deadly rescue mission, 48 people were sent back to their home country by the Maltese government

item.title: Developer freezes Lidl Malta funds over Żebbuġ site dispute
item.description: Central Business Centres says it has frozen an undisclosed bank guarantee provided by Lidl Malta after efforts to resolve a dispute over the redevelopment of the former Cortis Woodworks site in Żebbuġ failed

item.title: Health Ministry pursues legal action against MUMN over ‘abusive’ cath lab strike
item.description: The government is asking the courts to rule that industrial action at Mater Dei’s Cath Lab breached the law and endangered patient safety

item.title: Man hospitalised after collision in Ċirkewwa
item.description: The victim ended up stuck between two cars

item.title: Joseph Portelli exits CF Estates shareholding in €6.65 million deal
item.description: Construction magnate Joseph Portelli will exit CF Estates after agreeing to relinquish his 30% stake in the company, in a deal valued at around €6.65 million following a reduction of share capital

item.title: Looking back 2025 | Lawmakers and the mobility enigma
item.description: From road fatalities to traffic concerns and the endless discussion over a metro, we look back at the arguments that shaped the intense transport debate in 2025
